latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Early Morning Brief Output & Anti-Hallucination Enforcement

- Added strict hard template and output rules for the 早盘决策内参 (morning briefing) output type.
- Enforced precise, template-driven placeholders for all JSON-backed items; explicit instructions to never invent or infer data.
- Mandated evidence: minimum two real JSON evidence items for every actionable output in the morning brief.
- Introduced absolute anti-hallucination instructions (no external facts, no code/data fabrication, must label "数据不可用" or "数据不足X条" when data missing).
- Clarified examples and output structure for all morning brief fields; formatting requirements now strictly enforced.
- No code or logic changes; documentation/rules-only update.
